title: Stefon Diggs arraignment: Patriots WR to appear in court on felony charge

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Stefon Diggs arraignment: Patriots WR to appear in court on felony charge
sources.description: Patriots WR Stefon Diggs is accused of strangling his personal chef in December 2025 and is set to be arraigned in a Massachusetts court on Feb. 13.
